auteur: John A Beal, PhD Dep't. of Cellular Biology & Anatomy, Louisiana State University Health Sciences Center Shreveport
description: Human brainstem - anterior view - cerebral nerves II. N. opticus - The Optic nerves (II) are large & join at the midline to form the optic chiasm, then continue laterally as the optic tracts. The optic nerve is not a true nerve but rather a CNS tract.
